# Source provenance

This repository began as a clean, history-free source import from NetLab's
private FM10000 development baseline on 2026-08-11.

The import intentionally excluded vendor SDK material and modifications,
prebuilt third-party binaries, private release tooling and evidence, live lab
inventory, credentials, generated files, and the history that previously
contained runtime binaries. The public repository starts with an independent
Git history so deleted private or third-party objects are not reachable.

The Linux driver is maintained separately at
https://github.com/netlab-switch/netlab-fm10k-driver and is not copied here.
